'''Thunder Bluff''' is the faction of the [[Tauren]] capital city [[Thunder Bluff]] located in the northern part of the region of [[Mulgore]]. The whole of the city is built on bluffs several hundred feet above the surrounding landscape, and is accessible by elevators on the southwestern and northeastern sides.

== Reputation ==
[[Rumstag Proudstrider]] has the Thunder Bluff repeatable cloth quests used by non-tauren Horde players to obtain the right to ride [[kodo]]s at exalted.

Surrounding zones Mulgore and [[The Barrens]] have the most quests for gaining reputation with Thunder Bluff. 

== NPCs ==
NPCs aligned with the Thunder Bluff faction are mostly found in [[Desolace]], [[Feralas]], [[Mulgore]], [[The Barrens]], [[Thousand Needles]] and [[Thunder Bluff]]. Less common areas include [[Ashenvale]], [[Felwood]] and [[Stonetalon Mountains]].

== Rewards==
Tauren can ride [[kodo mounts]] by default, with a normal mount at level 30. Epic kodo mounts can be taught to ride at level 60.

Other Horde races who are {{rep|exalted}} with Thunder Bluff can also learn to ride kodo mounts.
